title: Inference metric collector abstraction and low-cardinality enrichment
creator: Avery Chen
description: Summary: Build a modular metric collector abstraction that sits between ingestion and our existing Prometheus/OTel exporters to standardize inference KPIs, enforce low-cardinality labeling, and provide hooks for lightweight enrichment (sampling, latency bucketing, model/version normalization). Goals: 1) Ensure consistent names and units for inference KPIs (request_latency_ms, tokens_generated, kv_cache_hit_ratio, model_fallback_count). 2) Reduce high-cardinality label explosion by key normalization and tag reduction rules (customer_id -> customer_tier, route -> route_group). 3) Provide per-tenant partial aggregation and sharded buffering to smooth bursts without dropping SLO signals. 4) Support dual export to Prometheus remote_write for high-cardinality telemetry and OTel metrics/OTLP for downstream analytics. 5) Expose tracing hooks to correlate spans with aggregated metrics (trace_id injection, span attributes). Acceptance criteria: - All new inference metrics emitted through abstraction must conform to our metric naming and unit guide and pass the linting job. - End-to-end tests that validate aggregation windowing and cardinality controls under 10k rps synthetic load. - Migration plan that keeps legacy exporters live for 2 weeks and provides gap dashboards showing parity. - Alerts for exporter backlog > 30s and dropped samples > 0.1% during rollout. Design notes: - Collector is a sidecar process for Dedicated/private installs and a shared service on hosted. - Uses a configurable pipeline: sanitize -> enrich -> aggregate -> shard -> export. Each stage is pluggable. - Cardinality rules: canonicalize model names, hash customer_id into buckets and map to customer_tier tag, drop request-specific dynamic tags (prompt_id, user_message_sha). - Aggregation windows: 10s for latency histograms, 60s for token counters; support async flush on shutdown. - Buffering: in-memory ring buffer with backpressure signals to caller; persistent spill to local disk in Private when configured. - Export paths: Prometheus remote_write for high-cardinality timeseries, OTLP/gRPC for aggregated metrics destined for analytics and long-term storage. Tradeoffs considered: - Losing per-request labels reduces debugging granularity but is necessary to contain cardinality and storage costs. We mitigate by providing a sampling mode (1/1000 requests) that forwards full labels to a debug stream. - Sidecar model increases ops complexity on Private but allows tenant isolation and independent scaling. Rollout plan: 1) Implement collector feature flagged behind obs-revamp. 2) Deploy to internal staging and run 2 weeks of canary traffic. 3) Enable sampling debug stream and validate parity dashboards. 4) Gradually migrate models/routes by route_group, monitor exporter backlog and dropped samples. 5) Flip default in hosted after 4 weeks of stable metrics. Monitoring and alerts: - Exporter backlog > 30s -> P1 on-call. - Dropped_samples_ratio > 0.1% sustained 5m -> paging. - Latency_histogram_p90 increase > 30% after migration -> investigate aggregation bug. Documentation and artifacts: - Metric naming and labels spec (Confluence link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/obs/metric-names) - Collector design doc (Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/docs/obs/collector-design) - Migration dashboard (Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/obs/migration-parity). Testing plan: - Unit tests for normalization and cardinality rules. - Load test harness that mimics 20k rps across many routes to validate buffer/backpressure. - E2E integration tests that assert parity for key KPIs within 1% error after aggregation. Safety and security: - Ensure no PII flows into metrics by enforcing schema blockers for common PII keys. - KMS-encrypted disk spill for Private when enabled. Implementation tasks: - Build core collector library and CLIs (Go) - Implement Prometheus remote_write exporter adapter - Implement OTLP exporter with optional histogram aggregation - Integrate trace_id propagation into tracing hooks - Add linting job for metric names and labels - Add migration dashboard and observability smoke tests
